full_prompt_en: A square finely detailed fantasy illustration shows a luminous palace rising above a deep blue forest beneath a star-filled night sky. The palace occupies the center and upper middle, built from many narrow towers, tall windows, stepped walls, pale domes, and tiny gold finials. Its largest cream-colored dome sits near the upper center, ringed by smaller spires that reach into the black sky. Below it, dark indigo trees gather in pointed overlapping masses, partly hiding the lower terraces and giving the bright structure a floating quality. A still strip of water spans the lower edge, reflecting thin gold and blue lines from the lights above. Small warm points along the forest edge and palace facade suggest lamps or windows. The sky is near black, densely sprinkled with white and gold stars, and a tiny bright flying shape appears toward the upper right. At both sides, long narrow dark forms frame the central glow. The drawing relies on exceptionally fine pale linework: window grids, decorative arches, minute roof edges, and clustered branch marks are all precisely placed. Flat areas of ultramarine, midnight blue, cream, and muted gold alternate with speckled print texture. The light seems to radiate from the pale architecture itself, while the surroundings stay cool and dark; its reflection is slight rather than a broad glossy mirror. The perspective is shallow and ornamental, with vertical layers stacked like an illuminated tale-book plate. The overall composition balances a concentrated cream-and-gold center against expansive dark blue margins and a quiet reflective base.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形精细奇幻插图描绘一座发光宫殿，在繁星夜空下升起于深蓝树林之上。宫殿占据中央与上中部，由许多细塔、高窗、层叠墙体、浅色圆顶和微小金色尖顶组成。最大的奶油色圆顶位于上方中央附近，周围小尖塔直抵黑色天空。其下，深靛蓝树林聚成尖形交叠体量，遮住部分下层平台，让明亮建筑仿佛漂浮。静止水带横过下缘，反映上方灯光的细金线与蓝线。树林边与宫殿立面上的小暖点暗示灯或窗。天空近乎纯黑，密布白金色星点；右上方有一个微小发亮的飞行形状。两侧细长深色体量框住中央光辉。绘画依靠极细浅色线描：窗格、装饰拱线、微小屋顶边缘和成簇枝线都精确排布。群青、午夜蓝、奶油色和低调金色的平面色域与斑点印刷肌理交替。光仿佛从浅色建筑自身放出，周围保持冷暗；水中的反光细窄，而非宽阔光亮镜面。透视浅而装饰性强，竖向层次像发光故事书画页般堆叠。整体构图以集中的奶油金色中心，平衡宽广深蓝边缘和安静的反光基底。
style_prompt_en: A finely ornamented fantasy illustration combines hairline pale detailing with flat midnight-blue, ultramarine, cream, and muted-gold fields. Countless pinpoints and speckles animate a near-black upper ground, while closely stacked vertical motifs form a dense luminous center. Deep indigo silhouettes screen lower layers and increase the contrast with pale intricate planes. Edges are precise and decorative, with subtle print grain softening otherwise flat fills. Light seems to emanate from the central pale areas, leaving the margins cool and dark; faint linear reflections below establish a quiet base. Depth is shallow and layered like an illuminated plate rather than fully atmospheric. The rhythm moves upward through narrow repeated lines, then settles into a broad dark surround, producing a hushed, jewel-like glow.
style_prompt_zh: 精细装饰奇幻插图把发丝般浅色细节与午夜蓝、群青、奶油色和低调金色平面色域结合。无数针尖亮点与斑点活跃近黑上方底面，紧密叠放的竖向纹样构成密集发光中心。深靛蓝剪影遮住下层，增强浅色繁密平面的对比。边缘精确而装饰性强，细微印刷颗粒柔化原本平坦的填色。光仿佛从中央浅色区域自身发出，边缘冷而暗；下方微弱线状倒影建立安静基底。纵深浅而分层，如发光画页而非完整大气透视。节奏沿窄而重复的线条向上移动，再安定于宽阔暗色外围，形成静谧宝石般光辉。
theme_en: A luminous palace rising above a blue forest beneath a starry night
theme_zh: 星夜下蓝色树林上方升起的发光宫殿
name: Kay Nielsen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
